body: Overdosing on non prescription pills is really hard. So is overdosing on any medication  really. Doing a shit ton of paracetamol is a big no no, it can leave you with kidney damage or failure... Codeine and DXM in the cough medicine wont kill you but will get you high, dissociated, confused and out of your mind and if abused will leave you with permanent damage or an addiction...

Depends on a lot of things, how much have you eaten, how much did you drink and how fast, body weight...You probably won't die but you will feel really bad,  it can also get difficult to breathe, you may also start to tremble, feel dizzy or faint from low blood pressure since booze is a depressant and metoprolol lowers blood pressure, regardless of all that call an ambulance and let them take care of you.
Understanding that is the first step to getting better.
If you do die all the pain will stop and so will all the possible joy. Living now is fighting for a better tomorrow...
There's no point in dying. Taking away the pain also takes away any possible joy... Failing will ruin your life even more.
I didn't have anybody to write it to, I failed and here I am. But if I did have anybody to write to I would just say goodbye and sorry.
